subject: Geopolitics
title: The INF Treaty Collapse
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The INF Treaty Collapse.

hook.text: In 2019 the US withdrew from the INF Treaty banning intermediate-range missiles. A Cold War guardrail vanished.

buildup.text: Signed by Reagan and Gorbachev in 1987, the INF eliminated an entire class of nuclear missiles from Europe.

discovery.text: The treaty worked because both sides verified compliance. Trust was built through inspections, not good faith.

twist.text: Russia cheated with a new cruise missile. The US left because staying in a broken treaty looked weak.

climax.text: Without the INF both sides can now deploy missiles that reach Europe in minutes. The risk window is open again.

punchline.text: Tearing up a treaty is easy. Rebuilding trust is not.

quiz.question: Why did the US withdraw from the INF Treaty?
options: It wanted to develop intermediate-range missiles for Asia
Russia was violating the treaty with a new cruise missile
The treaty was due to expire and wasn't renewed
